# 🔥🔥🔥[MeViS: A Multi-Modal Dataset for Referring Motion Expression Video Segmentation](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11130435)🔥🔥🔥

🏠 [Homepage](https://henghuiding.com/MeViS/) | 📄 [Paper](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11130435) | 🔗 [GitHub](https://github.com/henghuiding/MeViS)
## Download (Training set and validation set)
⬇️ Get the dataset from:

- 🤗 [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/FudanCVL/MeViSv2)
- ☁️ [Google Drive](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1cft6BC3xBe6HFsZOLA0riRwoUpKPP90-?usp=drive_link)

## Submission
The submission file should be a **.zip** pack contains the results on all videos. Like DAVIS2017, video folders should be put in the **root directory** of the zip. Make sure the filenames of the predicted frames match the filenames of the image frames.

Please check the sample submission in the download link for reference.
```
<submission.zip>
│ 
├── <video_name_1>
│ ├── 00000.png
│ ├── 00001.png
│ └── ...
│ 
├── <video_name_2>
│ ├── 00000.png
│ ├── 00001.png
│ └── ...
│ 
└── <video_name_...>
```
